Hi Alice,

Thanks again for taking the product + security discovery with us today — really helpful to better understand FinTechCo's requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Goals we heard: SOC 2 evidence for procurement, pen test report for third-party validation, and a clear vulnerability management SLA for production systems.
- Attachments I shared on the call: vendor questionnaire (attached) — feel free to complete the sections you prefer; we can also fill technical bits if helpful.

Requested items from FinTechCo for procurement review (if you can provide):
- Any minimum-security requirements or contract language that matters to procurement (e.g., data residency, encryption, retention).
- Preferred format for pen-test evidence (summary vs full report).

Redwood to provide:
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (we'll share with your procurement team under NDA).
- Recent internal pen test summary + follow-up remediation notes.
- Vulnerability management process summary (scan cadence, triage escalation, SLA targets).

Next steps / owners:
1) I will loop in our security lead, Neha, to share the SOC 2 report and pen-test artifact (Marissa -> Neha).
2) Please confirm whether you need the full pen-test report or a redacted summary (Alice).
3) If it helps, let's schedule a short security Q&A next week (Rishi can coordinate scheduling).

Attachment: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_FinTechCo.xlsx (xlsx - 120KB)

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,

Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — that matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement will want to see SOC 2 Type II and a pen test summary. Full pen-test results are ok under an NDA but procurement usually prefers a redacted report plus an executive summary we can share with stakeholders.
- For vulnerability management, please include scan cadence (I.e., external/internal scans frequency), how critical issues are triaged, and your typical SLA to remediation for P1/P2/P3.
- We also need to know whether Redwood handles any customer data that falls under HIPAA (we're not in healthcare, but data residency/GDPR treatment is relevant).

Could you share a time window next week for a short security Q&A (30 minutes)? Daily mornings EST work best for our security team.

Appreciate it,
Alice
Director of Vendor Risk — FinTechCo
alice.johnson@fintechco.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: SOC2 & pen test info

Hi Marissa / Alice — thanks for the thread. Quick answers + attached artifacts.

1) SOC 2: We have a current SOC 2 Type II report for the period Jan–Jun 2026. We can share the full report with FinTechCo under a mutual NDA. For procurement decks we typically provide a SOC 2 cover letter and a redacted copy first.

2) Pen test: Attached is the redacted pen-test report summary (FinTechCo_PenTest_Report_2026-06.pdf). The full report contains vendor details and reproductions and is available under NDA. The summary includes: 
- Scope: API endpoints, model-serving infra, auth flows (OAuth2 + API keys).
- Major findings: 1 critical (remediated within 72 hours), 3 high (remediated within 14 days), plus several medium/low issues.
- Verification: re-test confirmed fixes for critical/high findings.

3) Vulnerability Management (summary bullets):
- External scans: weekly automated external scan (third-party) + monthly manual external validation.
- Internal scans: weekly authenticated scans in staging; nightly static analysis as part of CI.
- Dependency scanning: continuous SCA via pipeline with high severity alerts for dev leads.
- SLA targets: P1 critical (fix/mitigate within 72 hours), P2 high (14 days), P3 medium (30 days) — exceptions tracked and escalated to CTO.
- Disclosure policy: Responsible disclosure accepted via security@redwood.com; triage within 48 hours, public disclosure considered only after coordinated release or 90-day window.

Attachment: FinTechCo_PenTest_Report_2026-06.pdf (pdf - redacted, 2.4MB)
Attachment: SOC2_Cover_Letter_2026.pdf (pdf - 45KB)

If you want the full SOC 2 or full pen-test under NDA, I can kick off the NDA template — Marissa, can you share the FinTechCo legal contact?

Happy to hop on a 30-minute call to walk through details.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
